WITH created AS (
  SELECT public.mp_sterilizer_start_run(
    p_planned_item_id => {{ Number.isFinite(Number(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue)) ? Number(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue) : "NULL" }}::bigint,
    p_planned_recipe_id => {{ String((qItems.data || []).find(i => String(i.nocopk) === String(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue))?.component_mode || "single_recipe").trim().toLowerCase() === "multi_recipe" ? "NULL" : (Number.isFinite(Number(selPlannedRecipe.selectedOptionValue)) ? Number(selPlannedRecipe.selectedOptionValue) : "NULL") }}::bigint,
    p_planned_count => {{ Number.isFinite(Number(inpPlannedCount.text)) ? Number(inpPlannedCount.text) : "NULL" }}::numeric,
    p_planned_unit_size => {{ Number.isFinite(Number(inpPlannedUnitSize.text)) ? Number(inpPlannedUnitSize.text) : "NULL" }}::numeric,
    p_process_type => {{ SterilizerIn.sql.str(selProcessType.selectedOptionValue) }}::text,
    p_start_time => {{ SterilizerIn.sql.ts(dpStartTime.selectedDate) }}::timestamp,
    p_operator => {{ SterilizerIn.sql.str(SterilizerIn.currentOperator()) }}::text,
    p_target_temp_c => {{ Number.isFinite(Number(txtTargetTemp.text)) ? Number(txtTargetTemp.text) : "NULL" }}::numeric,
    p_pressure_mode => {{ SterilizerIn.sql.str(txtPressureMode.text) }}::text,
    p_notes => {{ SterilizerIn.sql.str(inpRunNotes.text) }}::text,
    p_planned_component_set => {{ String((qItems.data || []).find(i => String(i.nocopk) === String(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue))?.component_mode || "single_recipe").trim().toLowerCase() === "multi_recipe" ? SterilizerIn.sql.str(selPlannedRecipe.selectedOptionValue) : "NULL" }}::text
  ) AS nocopk
)
SELECT sr.nocopk, sr.steri_run_id
FROM created c
JOIN public.sterilization_runs sr ON sr.nocopk = c.nocopk;

WITH created AS (
  SELECT public.mp_sterilizer_start_run(
    p_planned_item_id => {{ Number.isFinite(Number(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue)) ? Number(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue) : "NULL" }}::bigint,
    p_planned_recipe_id => {{ String((qItems.data || []).find(i => String(i.nocopk) === String(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue))?.component_mode || "single_recipe").trim().toLowerCase() === "multi_recipe" ? "NULL" : (Number.isFinite(Number(selPlannedRecipe.selectedOptionValue)) ? Number(selPlannedRecipe.selectedOptionValue) : "NULL") }}::bigint,
    p_planned_count => {{ Number.isFinite(Number(inpPlannedCount.text)) ? Number(inpPlannedCount.text) : "NULL" }}::numeric,
    p_planned_unit_size => {{ Number.isFinite(Number(inpPlannedUnitSize.text)) ? Number(inpPlannedUnitSize.text) : "NULL" }}::numeric,
    p_process_type => {{ SterilizerIn.sql.str(selProcessType.selectedOptionValue) }}::text,
    p_start_time => {{ SterilizerIn.sql.ts(dpStartTime.selectedDate) }}::timestamp,
    p_operator => {{ SterilizerIn.sql.str(SterilizerIn.currentOperator()) }}::text,
    p_target_temp_c => {{ Number.isFinite(Number(txtTargetTemp.text)) ? Number(txtTargetTemp.text) : "NULL" }}::numeric,
    p_pressure_mode => {{ SterilizerIn.sql.str(txtPressureMode.text) }}::text,
    p_notes => {{ SterilizerIn.sql.str(inpRunNotes.text) }}::text,
    p_planned_component_set => {{ String((qItems.data || []).find(i => String(i.nocopk) === String(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue))?.component_mode || "single_recipe").trim().toLowerCase() === "multi_recipe" ? SterilizerIn.sql.str(selPlannedRecipe.selectedOptionValue) : "NULL" }}::text
  ) AS nocopk

SELECT sr.nocopk, sr.steri_run_id
FROM created c
JOIN public.sterilization_runs sr ON sr.nocopk = c.nocopk;

WITH selected AS (
  SELECT
    {{ Number.isFinite(Number(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue || appsmith.store.ster_in_selected_item)) ? Number(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue || appsmith.store.ster_in_selected_item) : "NULL" }}::bigint AS item_id,
    {{ Number.isFinite(Number(inpPlannedUnitSize.text || appsmith.store.ster_in_unit_size)) ? Number(inpPlannedUnitSize.text || appsmith.store.ster_in_unit_size) : "NULL" }}::numeric AS unit_size_lb
),
selected_item AS (
  SELECT
    i.nocopk,
    lower(trim(COALESCE(i.component_mode, 'single_recipe'))) AS component_mode
  FROM public.items i
  JOIN selected s ON s.item_id = i.nocopk
),
recipe_options AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    r.nocopk::text AS option_value,
    r.name || CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(trim(r.recipe_id), '') IS NOT NULL THEN ' (' || r.recipe_id || ')'
      ELSE ''
    END AS option_label,
    'recipe'::text AS option_kind
  FROM selected s
  JOIN selected_item i ON true
  JOIN public.item_recipe_components irc
    ON irc.item_id = i.nocopk
   AND COALESCE(irc.active, false)
  JOIN public.recipes r
    ON r.nocopk = irc.recipe_id
   AND COALESCE(r.active, false)
  WHERE i.component_mode <> 'multi_recipe'
),
component_set_options AS (
  SELECT
    irc.component_set AS option_value,
    irc.component_set || ' — ' || string_agg(
      initcap(COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(irc.component_role), ''), 'component')) || ': ' ||
      CASE
        WHEN irc.default_weight_lb IS NOT NULL
          THEN irc.default_weight_lb::text || ' lb '
        WHEN irc.default_percent IS NOT NULL
          THEN irc.default_percent::text || '% '
        ELSE ''
      END || COALESCE(r.name, r.recipe_id, 'Recipe'),
      ' + ' ORDER BY irc.component_role, r.name, r.recipe_id
    ) AS option_label,
    'component_set'::text AS option_kind
  FROM selected s
  JOIN selected_item i ON true
  JOIN public.item_recipe_components irc
    ON irc.item_id = i.nocopk
   AND COALESCE(irc.active, false)
  JOIN public.recipes r
    ON r.nocopk = irc.recipe_id
   AND COALESCE(r.active, false)
  WHERE i.component_mode = 'multi_recipe'
    AND s.unit_size_lb IS NOT NULL
    AND irc.unit_size_lb = s.unit_size_lb
    AND NULLIF(trim(irc.component_set), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY irc.component_set
)
SELECT option_value, option_label, option_kind
FROM recipe_options
UNION ALL
SELECT option_value, option_label, option_kind
FROM component_set_options
ORDER BY option_label;

WITH selected AS (
  SELECT
    {{ Number.isFinite(Number(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue || appsmith.store.ster_in_selected_item)) ? Number(selPlannedItem.selectedOptionValue || appsmith.store.ster_in_selected_item) : "NULL" }}::bigint AS item_id,
    {{ Number.isFinite(Number(inpPlannedUnitSize.text || appsmith.store.ster_in_unit_size)) ? Number(inpPlannedUnitSize.text || appsmith.store.ster_in_unit_size) : "NULL" }}::numeric AS unit_size_lb
),
selected_item AS (
  SELECT
    i.nocopk,
    lower(trim(COALESCE(i.component_mode, 'single_recipe'))) AS component_mode
  FROM public.items i
  JOIN selected s ON s.item_id = i.nocopk
),
recipe_options AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    r.nocopk::text AS option_value,
    r.name || CASE
      WHEN NULLIF(trim(r.recipe_id), '') IS NOT NULL THEN ' (' || r.recipe_id || ')'
      ELSE ''
    END AS option_label,
    'recipe'::text AS option_kind
  FROM selected s
  JOIN selected_item i ON true
  JOIN public.item_recipe_components irc
    ON irc.item_id = i.nocopk
   AND COALESCE(irc.active, false)
  JOIN public.recipes r
    ON r.nocopk = irc.recipe_id
   AND COALESCE(r.active, false)
  WHERE i.component_mode <> 'multi_recipe'
),
component_set_options AS (
  SELECT
    irc.component_set AS option_value,
    irc.component_set || ' — ' || string_agg(
      initcap(COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(irc.component_role), ''), 'component')) || ': ' ||
      CASE
        WHEN irc.default_weight_lb IS NOT NULL
          THEN irc.default_weight_lb::text || ' lb '
        WHEN irc.default_percent IS NOT NULL
          THEN irc.default_percent::text || '% '
        ELSE ''
      END || COALESCE(r.name, r.recipe_id, 'Recipe'),
      ' + ' ORDER BY irc.component_role, r.name, r.recipe_id
    ) AS option_label,
    'component_set'::text AS option_kind
  FROM selected s
  JOIN selected_item i ON true
  JOIN public.item_recipe_components irc
    ON irc.item_id = i.nocopk
   AND COALESCE(irc.active, false)
  JOIN public.recipes r
    ON r.nocopk = irc.recipe_id
   AND COALESCE(r.active, false)
  WHERE i.component_mode = 'multi_recipe'
    AND s.unit_size_lb IS NOT NULL
    AND irc.unit_size_lb = s.unit_size_lb
    AND NULLIF(trim(irc.component_set), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY irc.component_set
)
SELECT option_value, option_label, option_kind
FROM recipe_options
UNION ALL
SELECT option_value, option_label, option_kind
FROM component_set_options
ORDER BY option_label;

    i.default_unit_size_oz AS item_default_unit_size_oz,
    i.default_unit_size_lb AS item_default_unit_size_lb,

    CASE
      WHEN l.harvest_weight_g IS NOT NULL AND l.harvest_weight_g::numeric > 0
        THEN l.harvest_weight_g::numeric
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(l.item_category_mat), ''), NULLIF(btrim(i.category), ''), ''))
           IN ('all_in_one_bag', 'casing', 'fruiting_block', 'grain', 'substrate')
           AND l.unit_size IS NOT NULL
           AND l.unit_size::numeric > 0
        THEN round((l.unit_size::numeric * 453.59237)::numeric, 2)
      WHEN i.default_unit_size_g IS NOT NULL AND i.default_unit_size_g::numeric > 0
        THEN i.default_unit_size_g::numeric
      WHEN i.default_unit_size_oz IS NOT NULL AND i.default_unit_size_oz::numeric > 0
        THEN round((i.default_unit_size_oz::numeric * 28.349523125)::numeric, 2)
      WHEN i.default_unit_size_lb IS NOT NULL AND i.default_unit_size_lb::numeric > 0
        THEN round((i.default_unit_size_lb::numeric * 453.59237)::numeric, 2)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS packageable_weight_g

  FROM public.vc_lots l
  LEFT JOIN public.items i
    ON (
      CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(l.item_id::text, '') ~ '^[0-9]+$'
          THEN l.item_id::bigint
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) = i.nocopk
    OR (
      COALESCE(l.item_id::text, '') <> ''

    )
)

actionConfiguration.body:
WITH ui_raw AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      {{ LotsSpawnToBulk.sql.str(
        inpStrains.selectedOptionValue && inpStrains.selectedOptionValue !== 'All'
          ? inpStrains.selectedOptionValue
          : 'All'
      ) }}::text,
      'All'
    ) AS selected_strain_raw,

    COALESCE(
      {{ LotsSpawnToBulk.sql.str((() => {
        const r = !!chkRegulated.isChecked;
        const u = !!chkUnRegulated.isChecked;

        if ((r && u) || (!r && !u)) return 'all';
        return r ? 'regulated' : 'unregulated';
      })()) }}::text,
      'all'
    ) AS regulated_mode_raw
),
ui AS (
  SELECT
    trim(both '''' from selected_strain_raw) AS selected_strain,
    trim(both '''' from regulated_mode_raw) AS regulated_mode
  FROM ui_raw
),
lot_rows AS (
  SELECT
    l.nocopk,
    l.lot_id,
    l.item_name_mat,
    l.item_category_mat,
    l.strain_id,
    l.strain_species_strain_mat,
    l.regulated_from_strain_id,

    CASE
      WHEN l.regulated_from_strain_id IS NULL THEN FALSE
      WHEN l.regulated_from_strain_id::text ILIKE '%true%' THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_regulated,

    l.vendor_name_mat,
    l.status,
    l.qty,
    l.unit_size,
    l.created_at,
    l.inoculated_at,
    loc.name AS storage_location
  FROM public.vc_lots l
  LEFT JOIN public.locations loc
    ON loc.nocopk = l.location_id
  WHERE regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.item_category_mat, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'grain'
    AND NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(l.strain_species_strain_mat, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.status, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN (
      'colonizing',
      'colonized',
      'fullycolonized',
      'fridge',
      'colonizedfridge'
    )
    AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.status, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') NOT IN (
      'retired',
      'consumed',
      'compost',
      'composted',
      'expired',
      'deleted',
      'spoiled'
    )
)

SELECT
  lr.nocopk,
  lr.lot_id,
  lr.item_name_mat,
  lr.item_category_mat,
  lr.strain_id,
  lr.strain_species_strain_mat,
  lr.regulated_from_strain_id,
  lr.vendor_name_mat,
  lr.status,
  lr.qty,
  lr.unit_size,
  lr.created_at,
  lr.inoculated_at,
  lr.storage_location
FROM lot_rows lr
CROSS JOIN ui
WHERE (
    ui.selected_strain = 'All'
    OR ui.selected_strain = ''
    OR lr.strain_species_strain_mat = ui.selected_strain
  )
  AND (
    ui.regulated_mode = 'all'
    OR (ui.regulated_mode = 'regulated' AND lr.is_regulated = TRUE)
    OR (ui.regulated_mode = 'unregulated' AND lr.is_regulated = FALSE)
  )
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(lr.inoculated_at, lr.created_at, now()) DESC,
  lr.nocopk DESC
LIMIT 500;

SELECT
  l.*,
  CASE
    WHEN l.terminal_at IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(l.terminal_reason, 'Terminal')
    WHEN l.first_harvest_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Harvesting / fruiting'
    WHEN l.fruiting_start_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Fruiting'
    WHEN l.spawned_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Spawned to bulk'
    WHEN l.fully_colonized_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Fully colonized'
    WHEN l.inoculated_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Colonizing'
    WHEN l.processed_at IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(l.processed_type, 'Processed')
    WHEN l.received_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Received'
    ELSE COALESCE(l.status, 'Recorded')
  END AS lifecycle_stage,
  CASE
    WHEN l.lifecycle_start_at IS NOT NULL THEN
      round((extract(epoch FROM (COALESCE(l.terminal_at, now()) - l.lifecycle_start_at)) / 86400.0)::numeric, 1)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS lifecycle_age_days,
  CASE
    WHEN l.contaminated_at IS NOT NULL AND l.lifecycle_start_at IS NOT NULL THEN
      round((extract(epoch FROM (l.contaminated_at - l.lifecycle_start_at)) / 86400.0)::numeric, 1)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS days_lifecycle_start_to_contamination,
  CASE
    WHEN l.contaminated_at IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN l.fruiting_start_at IS NOT NULL AND l.fruiting_start_at <= l.contaminated_at THEN 'Fruiting'
    WHEN l.spawned_at IS NOT NULL AND l.spawned_at <= l.contaminated_at THEN 'Spawned to bulk'
    WHEN l.fully_colonized_at IS NOT NULL AND l.fully_colonized_at <= l.contaminated_at THEN 'Fully colonized'
    WHEN l.inoculated_at IS NOT NULL AND l.inoculated_at <= l.contaminated_at THEN 'Colonization'
    WHEN l.processed_at IS NOT NULL AND l.processed_at <= l.contaminated_at THEN 'Post-processing'
    WHEN l.received_at IS NOT NULL AND l.received_at <= l.contaminated_at THEN 'Received'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS contamination_stage
FROM public.v_reporting_lot_lifecycle l
WHERE
  NULLIF({{ appsmith.store.selectedLotId || "" }}::text, '') IS NOT NULL
  AND l.lot_nocopk = NULLIF({{ appsmith.store.selectedLotId || "" }}::text, '')::bigint;

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT * FROM public.mp_reporting_cohort(
  p_date_basis     => {{ appsmith.store.reportingCohortFilters?.dateBasis || "lifecycle_start" }}::text,
  p_start_at       => NULLIF({{ appsmith.store.reportingCohortFilters?.startAt || "" }}::text, '')::timestamp,
  p_end_at         => NULLIF({{ appsmith.store.reportingCohortFilters?.endAt || "" }}::text, '')::timestamp,
  p_item_category  => NULLIF({{ appsmith.store.reportingCohortFilters?.itemCategory || "" }}::text, ''),
  p_item_name      => NULLIF({{ appsmith.store.reportingCohortFilters?.itemName || "" }}::text, ''),
  p_strain         => NULLIF({{ appsmith.store.reportingCohortFilters?.strain || "" }}::text, ''),
  p_grain_item     => NULLIF({{ appsmith.store.reportingCohortFilters?.grainItem || "" }}::text, ''),
  p_substrate_item => NULLIF({{ appsmith.store.reportingCohortFilters?.substrateItem || "" }}::text, ''),
  p_recipe         => NULL,
  p_regulated      => NULL,
  p_data_origin    => NULL
)
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    lot_id, item_name, species_strain, lifecycle_start_at,
    cohort_grain_age_at_spawn_days_avg AS grain_age_days,
    days_inoculation_to_fully_colonized AS colonization_days,
    days_spawn_to_fruiting AS spawn_to_fruiting_days,
    days_in_fruiting AS fruiting_days,
    flush_count, total_harvest_g, cohort_is_contaminated, terminal_reason, status,
    GREATEST(
      COALESCE(cohort_grain_age_at_spawn_days_avg, -1),
      COALESCE(days_inoculation_to_fully_colonized, -1),
      COALESCE(days_spawn_to_fruiting, -1),
      COALESCE(days_in_fruiting, -1)
    ) AS longest_stage_days
  FROM cohort
)
SELECT
  lot_id, item_name, species_strain,
  round(grain_age_days::numeric,1) AS grain_age_days,
  round(colonization_days::numeric,1) AS colonization_days,
  round(spawn_to_fruiting_days::numeric,1) AS spawn_to_fruiting_days,
  round(fruiting_days::numeric,1) AS fruiting_days,
  flush_count, round(total_harvest_g::numeric,1) AS total_harvest_g,
  CASE WHEN cohort_is_contaminated THEN 'Contaminated' WHEN terminal_reason IS NOT NULL THEN terminal_reason WHEN total_harvest_g IS NOT NULL THEN 'Harvested' ELSE COALESCE(status,'Active') END AS outcome,
  CASE
    WHEN longest_stage_days < 0 THEN '—'
    WHEN grain_age_days = longest_stage_days THEN 'Grain age at spawn'
    WHEN colonization_days = longest_stage_days THEN 'Colonization'
    WHEN spawn_to_fruiting_days = longest_stage_days THEN 'Spawn → fruiting'
    WHEN fruiting_days = longest_stage_days THEN 'Fruiting duration'
    ELSE 'Lifecycle duration'
  END AS longest_stage,
  CASE WHEN longest_stage_days < 0 THEN NULL ELSE round(longest_stage_days::numeric,1) END AS longest_stage_days
FROM scored
ORDER BY cohort_is_contaminated DESC, longest_stage_days DESC NULLS LAST, lifecycle_start_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;

WITH selected AS (

    NULLIF({{ appsmith.store.selectedLotId || "" }}::text, '') IS NOT NULL

canonical AS (
  SELECT
    NULL::text AS event_id,
    s.record_created_at AS event_time,
    'Record created'::text AS event,
    'Database record creation; this may be later than physical lifecycle start.'::text AS detail,
    'lots.created_at'::text AS source,
    NULL::text AS operator,
    NULL::text AS station,
    NULL::text AS product_id,
    NULL::jsonb AS fields_json,
    5 AS stage_order
  FROM selected s
  WHERE s.record_created_at IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL, s.received_at, 'Received', NULL, s.received_at_source, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL::jsonb, 10
  FROM selected s WHERE s.received_at IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL, s.processed_at, COALESCE(s.processed_type, 'Processed'), NULL, s.processed_at_source, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL::jsonb, 20
  FROM selected s WHERE s.processed_at IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL, s.inoculated_at, 'Inoculated', NULL, s.inoculated_at_source, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL::jsonb, 30
  FROM selected s WHERE s.inoculated_at IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL, s.fully_colonized_at, 'Fully colonized', NULL, s.fully_colonized_at_source, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL::jsonb, 40
  FROM selected s WHERE s.fully_colonized_at IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL, s.spawned_at, 'Spawned to bulk', NULL, s.spawned_at_source, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL::jsonb, 50
  FROM selected s WHERE s.spawned_at IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL, s.fruiting_start_at, 'Fruiting started', NULL, s.fruiting_start_at_source, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL::jsonb, 60
  FROM selected s WHERE s.fruiting_start_at IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL, s.contaminated_at, 'Contaminated',
    concat_ws(' · ',
      CASE WHEN s.days_inoculation_to_contamination IS NOT NULL THEN s.days_inoculation_to_contamination::text || ' days after inoculation' END
    ),
    s.contaminated_at_source, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL::jsonb, 80
  FROM selected s WHERE s.contaminated_at IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL
  SELECT NULL, s.terminal_at, COALESCE(s.terminal_reason, 'Terminal'),
    CASE WHEN s.terminal_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 'Terminal outcome: ' || s.terminal_reason ELSE NULL END,
    s.terminal_at_source, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL::jsonb, 90
  FROM selected s
  WHERE s.terminal_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT (
      s.contaminated_at IS NOT NULL
      AND s.terminal_at = s.contaminated_at
      AND lower(COALESCE(s.terminal_reason, '')) = 'contaminated'
    )
),
harvests AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e."timestamp" AS event_time,
    'Harvest'::text AS event,
    concat_ws(' · ',
      CASE
        WHEN public.mp_reporting_try_numeric(f.fields ->> 'flush_no') IS NOT NULL
          THEN 'Flush ' || public.mp_reporting_try_numeric(f.fields ->> 'flush_no')::text
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN public.mp_reporting_try_numeric(f.fields ->> 'harvest_weight_g') IS NOT NULL
          THEN public.mp_reporting_try_numeric(f.fields ->> 'harvest_weight_g')::text || ' g'
      END
    ) AS detail,
    'event:Harvest'::text AS source,
    e.operator,
    e.station,
    e.product_id::text AS product_id,
    f.fields AS fields_json,
    70 AS stage_order
  FROM public.events e
  JOIN selected s ON s.lot_nocopk = e.lot_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.mp_reporting_try_jsonb(e.fields_json) AS fields) f
  WHERE lower(COALESCE(e.type, '')) = 'harvest'
),
other_events AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e."timestamp" AS event_time,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(e.type, ''), 'Event') AS event,
    CASE WHEN e."timestamp" IS NULL THEN 'Historical event; timestamp unavailable.' ELSE NULL END AS detail,
    CASE WHEN e."timestamp" IS NULL THEN 'event:undated' ELSE 'event:' || COALESCE(NULLIF(e.type, ''), 'unknown') END AS source,
    e.operator,
    e.station,
    e.product_id::text AS product_id,
    public.mp_reporting_try_jsonb(e.fields_json) AS fields_json,
    75 AS stage_order
  FROM public.events e
  JOIN selected s ON s.lot_nocopk = e.lot_id
  WHERE
    e."timestamp" IS NULL
    OR lower(COALESCE(e.type, '')) NOT IN (
      'received', 'sterilized', 'pasteurized', 'inoculated', 'fullycolonized',
      'spawnedtobulk', 'fruitingstart', 'startfruiting',
      'harvest', 'contaminated', 'inviable', 'composted', 'consumed',
      'destroyed', 'expired', 'retired'
    )
),
combined AS (
  SELECT * FROM canonical
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM harvests
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM other_events
)
SELECT
  event_id,
  event_time,
  event,
  NULLIF(detail, '') AS detail,
  source,
  operator,
  station,
  product_id,
  fields_json
FROM combined
ORDER BY event_time ASC NULLS LAST, stage_order ASC, event_id ASC NULLS LAST;

  p.item_category_mat,
  p.net_weight_g,
  p.net_weight_oz,
  p.net_volume_ml,
  p.pack_date,
  p.use_by,
  p.storage_location_id,
  l.name AS storage_location,
  p.strain_id,
  s.species_strain,
  p.tray_state,
  p.harvest_flush_no,
  p.harvest_weight_g,
  p.harvested_at,
  p.origin_lot_ids_json,
  p.notes
FROM public.products p
LEFT JOIN public.items i ON i.nocopk = p.item_id
LEFT JOIN public.locations l ON l.nocopk = p.storage_location_id
LEFT JOIN public.strains s ON s.nocopk = p.strain_id
WHERE
  (
    (
        (
          NULLIF({{ selProductsCategory.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '') IS NULL
          OR p.item_category_mat = {{ selProductsCategory.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text
        )
        AND (
          NULLIF({{ selProductsLocation.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '') IS NULL
          OR p.storage_location_id = NULLIF({{ selProductsLocation.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '')::bigint
        )
        AND (
          NULLIF({{ selProductsStrain.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '') IS NULL
          OR p.strain_id = NULLIF({{ selProductsStrain.selectedOptionValue || "" }}::text, '')::bigint
        )
        AND (
          {{ !chkActiveProducts.isChecked }}::boolean
          OR (
            NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM regexp_split_to_table(
                lower(COALESCE(p.tray_state::text, '')),
                '[,;|]+'
              ) AS ts(state)
              WHERE regexp_replace(trim(ts.state), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN (
                'emptytray',
                'compost',
                'composted',
                'spoiled',
                'retired',
                'expired',
                'consumed',
                'shipped'
              )
            )
            AND regexp_replace(
              lower(COALESCE(l.name::text, '')),
              '[^a-z0-9]',
              '',
              'g'
            ) NOT IN (
              'compost',
              'consumed',
              'expired',
              'retired',
              'shipped'
            )
          )
        )
    )
    OR (
      NULLIF({{ appsmith.URL?.queryParams?.product || "" }}::text, '') IS NOT NULL
      AND lower(BTRIM(p.product_id)) = lower(BTRIM({{ appsmith.URL?.queryParams?.product || "" }}::text))
    )
  )
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN NULLIF({{ appsmith.URL?.queryParams?.product || "" }}::text, '') IS NOT NULL
     AND lower(BTRIM(p.product_id)) = lower(BTRIM({{ appsmith.URL?.queryParams?.product || "" }}::text))

  END,
  COALESCE(p.pack_date::timestamp, p.nc_created_at, now()) DESC,
  p.nocopk DESC

SELECT
  l.*,
  CASE
    WHEN concat_ws(
      ' ',
      COALESCE(l.item_name_mat::text, ''),
      COALESCE(l.recipe_name::text, ''),
      COALESCE(l.item_id::text, ''),
      COALESCE(l.recipe_id::text, '')
    ) ILIKE ANY (string_to_array('%cvg%,%coco verm%,%coir%', ','))
      THEN 'CVG'
    WHEN concat_ws(
      ' ',
      COALESCE(l.item_name_mat::text, ''),
      COALESCE(l.recipe_name::text, ''),
      COALESCE(l.item_id::text, ''),
      COALESCE(l.recipe_id::text, '')
    ) ILIKE ANY (string_to_array('%hardwood%,%masters mix%,%master''s mix%,%mm50%,%mm75%', ','))
      THEN 'Hardwood'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS substrate_group
FROM public.vc_lots l
WHERE regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.item_category_mat::text, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') = 'substrate'
  AND l.spawned_at IS NULL
  AND l.inoculated_at IS NULL
  AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.status::text, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN (
    'new',
    'planned',
    'sterilized',
    'pasteurized',
    'sealed'
  )
  AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.status::text, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') NOT IN (
    'spawned',
    'colonizing',
    'fullycolonized',
    'colonized',
    'fruiting',
    'frozen',
    'coldshock',
    'retired',
    'consumed',
    'compost',
    'composted',
    'expired',
    'deleted',
    'spoiled'
  )
ORDER BY COALESCE(l.sterilized_at, l.created_at, now()) DESC, l.nocopk DESC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH lot_rows AS (
  SELECT

WHERE regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(item_category_mat, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN (
    'grain',
    'lcflask',
    'plate',
    'cordycepssubstrate',
	  'cordycepscontainer',
    'allinonebag'
  )
  AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(status, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN (
    'planned',
    'sterilized',
    'pasteurized',
    'sealed',
    'new',
    'fridge'
  )
  AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(status, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') NOT IN (
    'consumed',
    'expired',
    'retired',
    'compost',
    'composted',
    'deleted'
  )
  AND inoculated_at IS NULL
  AND NULLIF(COALESCE(strain_species_strain_mat, ''), '') IS NULL
ORDER BY COALESCE(sterilized_at, created_at, now()) DESC, nocopk DESC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  nocopk,
  name,
  active
FROM public.vc_locations
WHERE active
  AND (
    name ILIKE '%Dark%'
    OR name ILIKE '%Incubat%'
    OR name ILIKE '%Coloniz%'
    OR name ILIKE '%Fridge%'
    OR name ILIKE '%Refrigerator%'
  )
  AND name NOT ILIKE '%Compost%'
  AND name NOT ILIKE '%Expired%'
  AND name NOT ILIKE '%Consumed%'
  AND name NOT ILIKE '%Retired%'
  AND name NOT ILIKE '%Shipped%'
  AND name NOT ILIKE '%Shipping%'
  AND name NOT ILIKE '%Product%'
  AND name NOT ILIKE '%Fulfillment%'
  AND name NOT ILIKE '%Freezer%'
  AND name NOT ILIKE '%Freeze Dryer%'

    WHEN name ILIKE '%Coloniz%' THEN 3
    WHEN name ILIKE '%Fridge%' OR name ILIKE '%Refrigerator%' THEN 4
    ELSE 9
  END,
  name;

WITH ui_raw AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(
      {{ LotsDrawSyringes.sql.str(
        inpStrains.selectedOptionValue && inpStrains.selectedOptionValue !== 'All'
          ? inpStrains.selectedOptionValue
          : 'All'
      ) }}::text,
      'All'
    ) AS selected_strain_raw,

    COALESCE(
      {{ LotsDrawSyringes.sql.str((() => {
        const r = !!chkRegulated.isChecked;
        const u = !!chkUnRegulated.isChecked;

        if ((r && u) || (!r && !u)) return 'all';
        return r ? 'regulated' : 'unregulated';
      })()) }}::text,
      'all'
    ) AS regulated_mode_raw
),
ui AS (
  SELECT
    trim(both '''' from selected_strain_raw) AS selected_strain,
    trim(both '''' from regulated_mode_raw) AS regulated_mode
  FROM ui_raw
),
lot_rows AS (
  SELECT
    l.*,

    CASE
      WHEN l.regulated_from_strain_id IS NULL THEN FALSE
      WHEN l.regulated_from_strain_id::text ILIKE '%true%' THEN TRUE
      ELSE FALSE
    END AS is_regulated
  FROM public.vc_lots l
  WHERE lower(COALESCE(l.item_category_mat, '')) = 'lc_flask'
    AND NULLIF(trim(COALESCE(l.strain_species_strain_mat, '')), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(l.remaining_volume_ml, 0)::numeric > 0
    AND regexp_replace(lower(COALESCE(l.status, '')), '[^a-z0-9]', '', 'g') IN (
      'planned',
      'sterilized',
      'pasteurized',
      'sealed',
      'inoculated',
      'spawned',
      'colonizing',
      'fullycolonized',
      'fridge',
      'coldshock',
      'fruiting',
      'frozen'
    )
)

SELECT
  lr.*
FROM lot_rows lr
CROSS JOIN ui
WHERE (
    ui.selected_strain = 'All'
    OR ui.selected_strain = ''
    OR lr.strain_species_strain_mat = ui.selected_strain
  )
  AND (
    ui.regulated_mode = 'all'
    OR (ui.regulated_mode = 'regulated' AND lr.is_regulated = TRUE)
    OR (ui.regulated_mode = 'unregulated' AND lr.is_regulated = FALSE)
  )
ORDER BY
  COALESCE(lr.inoculated_at, lr.created_at, now()) DESC,
  lr.nocopk DESC
LIMIT 1000;

      ),

inventory AS (

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------
     PRODUCTS
     --------------------------------------------------------- */
  SELECT
    'Product'::text AS inventory_type,
    ('product:' || p.nocopk::text) AS entity_key,
    p.product_id::text AS inventory_id,

    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(i.name, ''),
      NULLIF(p.name_mat, ''),
      p.product_id
    )::text AS name,

    s.species_strain::text AS species_strain,
    loc.name::text AS storage_location,
    NULL::text AS vendor_name,
    p.item_category_mat::text AS item_category,

    CASE
      WHEN p.product_id ILIKE params.search_text
        THEN 0
      WHEN p.product_id ILIKE params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 1
      WHEN p.product_id ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 2
      WHEN COALESCE(i.name, p.name_mat, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 3
      WHEN COALESCE(s.species_strain, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 4
      WHEN COALESCE(p.item_category_mat, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 5
      ELSE 99
    END AS match_rank

  FROM public.products p

  LEFT JOIN public.items i
    ON i.nocopk = p.item_id

  LEFT JOIN public.locations loc
    ON loc.nocopk = p.storage_location_id

  LEFT JOIN public.strains s
    ON s.nocopk = p.strain_id

  CROSS JOIN params

  WHERE
    params.search_text IS NOT NULL
    AND length(params.search_text) >= 2
    AND CONCAT_WS(
      ' ',
      p.product_id,
      i.name,
      p.name_mat,
      s.species_strain,
      p.item_category_mat,
      loc.name
    ) ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'

        THEN 1
      WHEN lot.lot_id ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 2

        THEN 3
      WHEN COALESCE(s.species_strain, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 4
      WHEN COALESCE(lot.vendor_name, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 5
      WHEN COALESCE(lot.item_category_mat, '') ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
        THEN 6
      ELSE 99
    END AS match_rank

  FROM public.lots lot

  LEFT JOIN public.items i
    ON i.nocopk = lot.item_id

  LEFT JOIN public.locations loc
    ON loc.nocopk = lot.location_id

  LEFT JOIN public.strains s
    ON s.nocopk = lot.strain_id

  CROSS JOIN params

  WHERE
    params.search_text IS NOT NULL
    AND length(params.search_text) >= 2
    AND CONCAT_WS(
      ' ',
      lot.lot_id,
      i.name,
      lot.item_name_mat,
      s.species_strain,
      lot.vendor_name,
      lot.item_category_mat,
      loc.name
    ) ILIKE '%' || params.search_text || '%'
)

SELECT

  inventory_type,
  inventory_id,
  name,

  storage_location,
  vendor_name,
  item_category,

  CONCAT_WS(

SELECT
  c.nocopk,
  c.component_id,
  COALESCE(c.active, false) AS active,
  c.item_id AS item_nocopk,
  i.item_id,
  i.name AS item_name,
  i.component_mode,
  i.size_source,
  c.component_set,
  c.recipe_id AS recipe_nocopk,
  r.recipe_id,
  r.name AS recipe_name,
  c.component_role,
  c.unit_size_lb,
  c.default_weight_lb,
  c.default_percent,
  c.sort_order,
  c.notes
FROM public.item_recipe_components c
JOIN public.items i ON i.nocopk = c.item_id
LEFT JOIN public.recipes r ON r.nocopk = c.recipe_id
WHERE c.item_id = NULLIF({{ String(this.params.item_id ?? '') }}, '')::bigint
ORDER BY COALESCE(c.active, false) DESC,
         NULLIF(btrim(c.component_set), '') NULLS FIRST,
         c.unit_size_lb NULLS FIRST,
         COALESCE(c.sort_order, 999999), c.nocopk;

  r.name AS recipe_name,

  c.default_percent,

  c.notes
FROM public.item_recipe_components c
JOIN public.items i ON i.nocopk = c.item_id
LEFT JOIN public.recipes r ON r.nocopk = c.recipe_id
WHERE c.item_id = NULLIF({{ String(this.params.item_id ?? '') }}, '')::bigint
ORDER BY COALESCE(c.active, false) DESC,
         NULLIF(btrim(c.component_set), '') NULLS FIRST,
         c.unit_size_lb NULLS FIRST,
         COALESCE(c.sort_order, 999999), c.nocopk;

SELECT

WHERE s.recipe_id = NULLIF({{ String(this.params.recipe_id ?? '') }}, '')::bigint

ORDER BY COALESCE(s.section_order, 999999), COALESCE(s.step_order, 999999), s.nocopk;

SELECT
  ri.nocopk,
  ri.recipe_ingredient_id,
  ri.recipe_id AS recipe_nocopk,
  i.ingredient_id,
  i.name AS ingredient_name,
  ri.amount,
  ri.amount_max,
  ri.quantity_text,
  ri.unit,
  ri.vendor_name,
  ri.alternative_group,
  ri.parent_recipe_ingredient_id AS parent_recipe_ingredient_nocopk,
  pri.recipe_ingredient_id AS parent_recipe_ingredient_id,
  pi.ingredient_id AS parent_ingredient_id,
  pi.name AS parent_ingredient_name,
  COALESCE(ri.optional, false) AS optional,
  ri.sort_order,
  COALESCE(ri.active, false) AS active,
  ri.notes
FROM public.recipe_ingredients ri
JOIN public.ingredients i ON i.nocopk = ri.ingredient_id
LEFT JOIN public.recipe_ingredients pri ON pri.nocopk = ri.parent_recipe_ingredient_id
LEFT JOIN public.ingredients pi ON pi.nocopk = pri.ingredient_id
WHERE ri.recipe_id = NULLIF({{ String(this.params.recipe_id ?? '') }}, '')::bigint
  AND COALESCE(ri.active, false) = true
ORDER BY COALESCE(ri.sort_order, 999999), i.name, ri.nocopk;

WITH saved AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT *
  FROM public.mp_recipe_admin_save(
    NULLIF({{ String(this.params.nocopk ?? '') }}, '')::bigint,
    {{ this.params.recipe_id || '' }}::text,
    {{ this.params.name || '' }}::text,
    {{ this.params.category || '' }}::text,
    {{ this.params.active === true }}::boolean,
    {{ this.params.notes || '' }}::text
  )
),
document_metadata AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT m.*
  FROM saved s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.mp_recipe_document_metadata_save(
    s.nocopk,
    {{ this.params.description || '' }}::text,
    {{ this.params.batch_yield_text || '' }}::text
  ) m
)
SELECT
  s.nocopk,
  s.recipe_id,
  s.active,
  s.name,
  s.category,
  s.ingredients,
  s.notes,
  m.description,
  m.batch_yield_text
FROM saved s
JOIN document_metadata m ON m.nocopk = s.nocopk;

WITH saved AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT *
  FROM public.mp_recipe_admin_save(
    NULLIF({{ String(this.params.nocopk ?? '') }}, '')::bigint,
    {{ this.params.recipe_id || '' }}::text,
    {{ this.params.name || '' }}::text,
    {{ this.params.category || '' }}::text,
    {{ this.params.active === true }}::boolean,
    {{ this.params.notes || '' }}::text
  )
),
document_metadata AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT m.*
  FROM saved s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.mp_recipe_document_metadata_save(
    s.nocopk,
    {{ this.params.description || '' }}::text,
    {{ this.params.batch_yield_text || '' }}::text
  ) m
)
SELECT
  s.nocopk,
  s.recipe_id,
  s.active,
  s.name,
  s.category,
  s.ingredients,
  s.notes,
  m.description,
  m.batch_yield_text
FROM saved s
JOIN document_metadata m ON m.nocopk = s.nocopk;

SELECT
  s.nocopk,
  s.recipe_step_id,
  s.recipe_id AS recipe_nocopk,
  r.recipe_id,
  r.name AS recipe_name,
  s.active,

  s.instruction,
  s.notes,
  s.nc_created_at,
  s.nc_updated_at
FROM public.recipe_steps s
JOIN public.recipes r ON r.nocopk = s.recipe_id
WHERE s.recipe_id = NULLIF({{ String(this.params.recipe_id ?? '') }}, '')::bigint
ORDER BY COALESCE(s.section_order, 999999), COALESCE(s.step_order, 999999), s.nocopk;

SELECT
  s.nocopk,
  s.recipe_step_id,
  s.recipe_id AS recipe_nocopk,
  r.recipe_id,
  r.name AS recipe_name,
  s.active,
  s.section,
  s.section_order,
  s.step_order,
  s.instruction,
  s.notes,
  s.nc_created_at,
  s.nc_updated_at
FROM public.recipe_steps s
JOIN public.recipes r ON r.nocopk = s.recipe_id
WHERE s.recipe_id = NULLIF({{ String(this.params.recipe_id ?? '') }}, '')::bigint
ORDER BY COALESCE(s.section_order, 999999), COALESCE(s.step_order, 999999), s.nocopk;

SELECT
  i.nocopk,
  i.item_id,
  COALESCE(i.active, false) AS active,
  i.name,
  i.category,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(i.component_mode), ''), 'none') AS component_mode,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(i.size_source), ''), '') AS size_source,
  i.default_unit_size_lb,
  i.sort_order
FROM public.items i
ORDER BY COALESCE(i.active, false) DESC, COALESCE(i.sort_order, 999999), i.item_id, i.nocopk;

SELECT
  i.nocopk,
  i.item_id,
  COALESCE(i.active, false) AS active,
  i.name,
  i.category,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(i.component_mode), ''), 'none') AS component_mode,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(i.size_source), ''), '') AS size_source,
  i.default_unit_size_lb,
  i.sort_order
FROM public.items i
ORDER BY COALESCE(i.active, false) DESC, COALESCE(i.sort_order, 999999), i.item_id, i.nocopk;

SELECT
  i.nocopk,
  i.ingredient_id,
  i.active,
  i.name,
  i.category,
  i.default_unit,
  i.preferred_vendor,
  i.notes,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ri.recipe_id) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(ri.active, false))::integer AS active_recipe_count
FROM public.ingredients i
LEFT JOIN public.recipe_ingredients ri ON ri.ingredient_id = i.nocopk
GROUP BY i.nocopk, i.ingredient_id, i.active, i.name, i.category,
         i.default_unit, i.preferred_vendor, i.notes
ORDER BY i.active DESC, i.name, i.ingredient_id, i.nocopk;

SELECT
  i.nocopk,
  i.ingredient_id,
  i.active,
  i.name,
  i.category,
  i.default_unit,
  i.preferred_vendor,
  i.notes,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ri.recipe_id) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(ri.active, false))::integer AS active_recipe_count
FROM public.ingredients i
LEFT JOIN public.recipe_ingredients ri ON ri.ingredient_id = i.nocopk
GROUP BY i.nocopk, i.ingredient_id, i.active, i.name, i.category,
         i.default_unit, i.preferred_vendor, i.notes
ORDER BY i.active DESC, i.name, i.ingredient_id, i.nocopk;
